observations: Standing fan with a circular metal grille.
The brand 'OX' is visible on a red oval badge at the center of the grille in photo 0.
The fan has a green painted metal stand with a four-point cross base.
A black power cord is visible, trailing from the base.
The fan blades are not clearly visible through the grille in the provided photo.
The background appears to be a dark, possibly reflective surface like a garage door.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible, but the size (20 inches) cannot be confirmed from a single photo of the grille.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The fan may not be functional or may have a broken motor.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan blades spinning at all speed settings.

risks.risk: The motor may be excessively noisy or have a high vibration level.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the fan running.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or the plug may be faulty.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the plug and the full length of the cord.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the fan powered on and running through all speed settings.
Clear photo of the power plug and the full length of the cord.
Close-up photo of the motor housing to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
